titre: Team Cherry will share an ‘update’ on Silksong’s DLC on November 27
chapo: Silksong's DLC could get a release date this week
extrait: Team Cherry will hold a showcase on November 27, this Friday, with news about Hollow Knight: Silksong’s upcoming DLC, Sea of Sorrow. Team Cherry isn’t clear on what news will be shared, other than that the showcase will include an “update” on the DLC. Many are speculating that this could be anything from a delay to a shadowdrop. “Join us for Cherry Time!” reads the live stream’s description. “A special presentation with a bunch of exciting announcements, and an update on Hollow Knight: Silksong – Sea of Sorrow!” Sea of Sorrow being shadowdropped during the showcase would line up with what we were previously told by Team Cherry, as the DLC was given a 2026 release window. It’s also possible that the DLC will be given a December release date, just weeks away from now, if Team Cherry hasn’t made the decision to delay it into 2027. Join us in 48 hours for Cherry Time!Get ready for a bunch of exciting announcements, plus an update on Hollow Knight: Silksong - Sea of Sorrow!Premiering here: https://t.co/cYbSlADtPx pic.twitter.com/iXm4sDcjo5 Many publishers are avoiding this release window altogether, given all of the attention on GTA 6 right now. However, Silksong – which launched last September – was in a similar position to GTA 6, with fans eagerly awaiting news and its eventual release. So, it stands to reason that its long-awaited expansion could go up against the industry titan. Whenever Sea of Sorrow launches, we know that it will be made available as a free update for everyone who owns Silksong’s base game. It will include new areas to explore and bosses to fight. Given that Cherry Time is a showcase format, it seems that the developer has more to reveal on top of this, too. It’s possible we’ll get another game reveal as part of the showcase. Many will be hoping for another Hollow Knight game to be teased, but since the wait for Silksong itself was so long, it seems unlikely that Team Cherry would announce a follow-up until there is much to show of it.

titre: Hollow Knight: Silksong Dev Officially Breaks Silence on Sea Of Sorrow DLC With New Showcase
chapo: Team Cherry will reveal new details on Hollow Knight Silksong's DLC, Sea of Sorrow, during a special showcase called Cherry Time on Friday, Nov. 27.
extrait: Hollow Knight fans are in for a sweet Black Friday. Developer Team Cherry announced Wednesday that it's planning a "special presentation with a bunch of exciting announcements" for Friday titled Cherry Time, which promises a long-awaited update on Hollow Knight: Silksong - Sea of Sorrow, the upcoming expansion to Silksong. The Cherry Time special presentation will be streamed on Team Cherry's YouTube channel on Friday, Nov. 27 at 10 a.m. EST/7 a.m. PST. The studio did not announce how long the event will be. Hollow Knight: Silksong was released in September 2025, after a notoriously torturous wait for Hollow Knight fans. A few months later, Team Cherry announced an expansion for the game titled Sea of Sorrow. The DLC promises new areas, bosses, tools, and more, according to Team Cherry. The studio said at the time of Hollow Knight: Silksong - Sea of Sorrow's announcement that Hornet's next adventure would be a "nautically themed expansion, coming free for all players next year." With 2026 coming to a close in just five weeks, the window to meet Team Cherry's release target is quickly closing. Friday's Cherry Time showcase could either reveal a release date for the DLC (or release it as a surprise) or announce a delay until 2027. Hopefully, it's the former. Even if it's the latter, Hollow Knight fans are certainly used to waiting. It's just heartening to know that Team Cherry finally feels ready to talk about Silksong's DLC again. Hollow Knight: Silksong is available on Linux, Mac, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows PC, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X. The original Hollow Knight is also available on those platforms.

titre: Le DLC de Hollow Knight Silksong se rapproche, Team Cherry va prendre la parole en fin de semaine
chapo: ActuGaming.net Le DLC de Hollow Knight Silksong se rapproche, Team Cherry va prendre la parole en fin de semaine On l’a compris durant toutes ces années passées à attendre Hollow Knight Silksong : Team […] L'article Le DLC de Hollow Knight Silksong se rapproche, Team Cherry va prendre la parole en fin de semaine est disponible sur ActuGaming.net
extrait: On l’a compris durant toutes ces années passées à attendre Hollow Knight Silksong : Team Cherry n’est pas très causeur. Le studio préfère le mutisme complet au lieu de donner des bribes d’informations au compte-gouttes de ces projets, et cette stratégie se ressent à nouveau pour le DLC Sea of Sorrow. Mais ce silence radio va prendre fin, car Team Cherry vient d’annoncer un livestream un peu spécial. Il aurait pu se garder l’information pour les Game Awards, mais visiblement, Team Cherry préfère communiquer en solo dans son coin. Le studio derrière Hollow Knight Silksong vient d’annoncer un livestream « Cherry Time! » dans lequel il promet « pas mal d’annonces palpitantes » tout en promettant de donner des nouvelles de Sea of Sorrow. On devrait donc en toute logique connaître la date de sortie de ce contenu, en espérant qu’il arrive relativement vite pour replonger dans cet épisode. Il est intéressant de noter que le studio ne prévoit donc pas que de parler de l’extension, même s’il s’agira sans doute ici de son annonce majeure. N’espérez sans doute pas trop d’annonces autour d’éventuels autres jeux, mais peut-être des produits dérivés, des adaptations ou encore des annonces sur la structure du studio. L’événement sera en tout cas à suivre sur YouTube ce 27 novembre à 16 heures. Rappelons que normalement, Sea of Sorrow devrait être une extension gratuite pour Hollow Knight Silksong, qui sortira sur toutes les plateformes où le jeu est disponible, c’est-à-dire… eh bien partout, sur toutes les machines de cette génération et celles de la précédente ainsi que sur la plupart des boutiques en ligne, sauf l’Epic Games Store. Un véritable MMORPG PC à retrouver sur smartphone Commençons par ce qui constitue probablement l’un des principaux atouts de cette nouvelle version. En effet, Broken Ranks ne se présente pas comme une déclinaison simplifiée de son homologue sur PC. Whitemoon Games a choisi de transposer l’ensemble de son univers et de ses principales mécaniques sur Android, sans repartir sur un jeu entièrement différent.
